Assignment Title: Operating System

Assignment Question:
An operating system manages different types of processes. Each process has a process ID and a burst time (the time required by the process to complete execution).
Create an abstract class Process with:
- processId – stores the process ID.
- burstTime – stores the burst time.
- A constructor to initialize these values.
- An abstract method calculateTime() to calculate the execution time.
- A concrete method displayDetails() to display the process information.
Create a class CPUProcess that extends Process and implements the calculateTime() method.
For this simple scheduling system, assume:
Execution Time = Burst Time + 2 ms context switching time
The program should read the process ID and burst time and display the execution time.
Input Format
The input consists of two lines:
Process ID
Burst Time
- 
Process ID is an integer.
- 
Burst Time is an integer representing time in milliseconds.
Output Format
Display:
Process ID: <processId>
Burst Time: <burstTime> ms
Execution Time: <executionTime> ms
Sample Test Case
Input
101
10
Output
Process ID: 101
Burst Time: 10 ms
Execution Time: 12 ms
